A novel constructive approach using sphere codes constrained to graph Laplacians. Unlike the parent construction that increments grid resolution, this method leverages the structure of optimal codes on Hamming graphs suited for energy minimization. The key insight is that the maximum off-diagonal entry in hᵀCov(h) must be bounded below by the energy of an optimal Grassmannian code, suggesting a connection to spherepacking bounds. We develop a "codebook projection" transform that integrates the simplex structure potential of NFW's record-setting solution while retaining feasibility. The method systematically searches the 2D toroidal grid for energy-minimizing patterns.
